Objective: Verify post-reset state after active-low synchronous reset (RST_i=0): both A/B BRAM buffers are ready to accept data (tready=1), FIFO counter fifo_cnt_r=0, and output m_axis_c32_tvalid_o=0.
Stimulus: Hold RST_i=0 for 10 cycles, then assert RST_i=1 and keep s_axis_a/b_tvalid_i=0 for 20 cycles with k_dim_i=32, num_k_tiles_i=1.
Checks: Verify s_axis_a_tready_o==1, s_axis_b_tready_o==1, m_axis_c32_tvalid_o==0, m_axis_c32_tlast_o==0, m_axis_c32_tuser_o==0, and no X/Z values on any control signals.
Expected_result: Both Slave A/B channels assert tready=1; Master C32 channel holds tvalid=0 strictly when no input data has been supplied.
Notes: Confirms both bank_ready_0_r and bank_ready_1_r are cleared to 0 after reset.
Bug_Injection_Target: Inverting RST_i polarity or failing to clear bank_ready_0_r on reset -> s_axis_tready_o=0 from start -> TB reports FAIL.
Pass_Criteria: tready_o==1 on A/B; tvalid_o==0 on C32; 0 X/Z errors.

Objective: Verify a single 16x16 tile multiplication (k_dim=32, num_k_tiles=1) and confirm the row-order inversion mechanism (bottom-up drain from the systolic array is inverted by post_accumulator so C[0] exits first and C[15] exits last).
Stimulus: Set k_dim_i=32, num_k_tiles_i=1; stream matrix A[16][32] with distinct elements per (row, k) and B[32][16] such that every row C[0..15] and every column C[][0..15] produces a unique integer signature.
Checks: Verify the 16 beats output on m_axis_c32_tdata_o: beat r (r=0..15) must correspond to row C[r][0..15] (no duplicate row 15 from premature drain and no reversed C[15]..C[0] ordering); verify m_axis_c32_tuser_o=1 only at r=0 (SOF) and m_axis_c32_tlast_o=1 only at r=15 (EOF).
Expected_result: All 16 rows C[0]..C[15] exit in exact order 0 to 15; tuser=1 exclusively at row 0; tlast=1 exclusively at row 15; all 256 INT32 elements match 100%.
Notes: Directly verifies the duplicate Row 15 bug fix in output_serializer.v (line 42) and the TLAST/row-inversion fix acc_ram_r[N-1-out_cnt_r] in post_accumulator.v (lines 117-122).
Bug_Injection_Target: Changing acc_ram_r[N-1-out_cnt_r] to acc_ram_r[out_cnt_r] at post_accumulator.v:L117 or asserting fifo_wr_en_o=1 in IDLE at output_serializer.v:L42 -> TB immediately reports row-order mismatch.
Pass_Criteria: 256/256 INT32 elements match golden; tuser=1 at row 0; tlast=1 at row 15.

Objective: Verify the diagonal delay network (skew_network: row/column i delayed by exactly i cycles) ensuring A[i][k], B[k][j], and control signals valid/clear_acc/last_mac arrive simultaneously at PE(i,j) at cycle T0 + k + i + j.
Stimulus: Run k_dim_i=16, num_k_tiles_i=1 with impulse stimuli along step k (set A[i][k_test] != 0 and B[k_test][j] != 0 at only a single step k_test in {0, 1, 7, 14, 15}, with all other k steps set to 0).
Checks: Verify that every PE(i,j) across all 4 corners of the array—PE(0,0) (delay 0), PE(0,15) (delay 15), PE(15,0) (delay 15), and PE(15,15) (delay 30)—receives the exact pair (A[i][k_test], B[k_test][j]) without slipping to k_test-1 or k_test+1; verify clear_acc at k=0 clears stale sums and last_mac at k=k_dim-1 latches the final sum into hold_psum_r.
Expected_result: All 4 corner PEs—PE(0,0), PE(0,15), PE(15,0), PE(15,15)—and all 256 PEs produce exact products for every impulse position k_test=0, 1, 7, 14, 15.
Notes: If the diagonal delay of data and clear_acc/last_mac differs by even 1 cycle on row i>0, the bottom-right PEs will miss the final k step or fail to clear the accumulator at k=0.
Golden_Reference_Rule: For A[i][k] = (k==k_test ? a_i : 0), B[k][j] = (k==k_test ? b_j : 0) => C32[i][j] = a_i * b_j.
Bug_Injection_Target: Changing row i DELAY in skew_network.v to i+1 or failing to delay last_mac -> rows i>0 lose the product at k=k_dim-1 -> TB reports FAIL.
Pass_Criteria: 0 errors across all 256 PEs for both k_test=0 (first boundary) and k_test=15 (last boundary).

Objective: Verify signed INT8 x INT8 -> INT32 multiply-accumulate arithmetic in mac_core at negative/positive extremes: (-128)x(-128) = +16384, (-128)x(+127) = -16256, (+127)x(+127) = +16129 accumulated over a deep K dimension (K = 256 and K = 4096).
Stimulus: Configure k_dim_i=256, num_k_tiles_i=16 (total K = 4096 accumulation steps). Drive A and B lanes with all -128 (8'h80), all +127 (8'h7F), alternating +127/-128, and 0.
Checks: Verify after 4096 accumulation steps: (-128)*(-128)*4096 = +67,108,864; (-128)*(+127)*4096 = -66,584,576; alternating terms cancel to 0. Ensure 8'h80 is treated as signed -128 rather than unsigned +128.
Expected_result: All 256 C32 elements match 32-bit signed arithmetic 100% with no overflow or unsigned multiplication errors.
coverage_target: cg_mac_arith: min_x_min_pos, min_x_max_neg, max_x_max_pos, alternating_cancel, depth_4096 (100%)
Notes: If multiplied as unsigned, 8'h80 * 8'h80 would still be +16384, but 8'h80 * 8'h01 would become +128 instead of -128.
Bug_Injection_Target: Removing the $signed keyword in mac_core.v or post_accumulator.v:L46 -> multiplication by -128 (0x80) or negative addition produces wrong sign -> TB reports FAIL.
Pass_Criteria: 256/256 INT32 elements match 100% after 4096 accumulation steps.

Objective: Verify all valid k_dim_i values {16, 32, 64, 128, 256}, especially k_dim < MIN_PERIOD (k_dim = 16 and k_dim = 32 < 48), confirming the controller automatically waits at least 48 cycles between consecutive chunks so hold_psum_r is not overwritten before output_serializer finishes draining.
Stimulus: Preload 2 consecutive chunks into both ping-pong banks of bram_input_buffer (next_ready_A=1, next_ready_B=1) with distinct data for chunk 0 and chunk 1; run sequentially for k_dim_i = 16, 32, 64, 128, 256 with num_k_tiles_i = 4.
Checks: Measure the cycle interval between consecutive clear_delay_o pulses (chunk start): for k_dim=16 and 32, the interval must be >= 48 cycles (enforced by period_ok_w at line 65); for k_dim >= 64, the next chunk chains back-to-back with zero bubbles after k_dim cycles. Verify the 4-chunk accumulated sum is uncorrupted.
Expected_result: C32 results are 100% accurate for both k_dim=16, 32 (stalled to respect MIN_PERIOD=48) and k_dim=64, 128, 256 (zero-bubble chaining).
coverage_target: cg_k_dim: kd_16_min_period, kd_32_min_period, kd_64_zero_bubble, kd_128, kd_256 (100%)
Notes: Without the MIN_PERIOD=48 guard at systolic_dataflow_ctrl.v:L65, when k_dim=16 or 32, PE(0,0) of the next chunk would overwrite hold_psum_r before the serializer finished shifting out all 16 rows of the previous chunk!
Golden_Reference_Rule: Interval between chunk starts = max(k_dim + (k_dim < 48 ? DONE_cycle : 0), 48); C32 matches golden.
Bug_Injection_Target: Reducing MIN_PERIOD from 48 to 16 at systolic_dataflow_ctrl.v:L23 when running k_dim=16 -> chunk 2 overwrites hold_psum_r of chunk 1 -> TB catches the C32 corruption immediately.
Pass_Criteria: 0 data errors across all k_dim in {16,32,64,128,256}; SVA confirms inter-chunk interval >= 48 cycles.

Objective: Verify zero-bubble Ping-Pong bank switching (go_chain_w=1 at line 101 of systolic_dataflow_ctrl.v) when k_dim >= 48 (e.g., k_dim=64) and the next bank is fully loaded before the current chunk finishes.
Stimulus: Set k_dim_i=64, num_k_tiles_i=4. Stream chunk 0 and chunk 1 into BRAM A/B at maximum rate (1 beat/cycle) so next_ready_A_i=1 and next_ready_B_i=1 before chunk 0 reaches k_cnt_r=63.
Checks: Verify that at k_cnt_r=63 of chunk 0, state_r remains in RUN (without transitioning through DONE/IDLE), valid_delay_o stays at 1 continuously for 2*64 = 128 cycles with zero dead cycles, and beat 0 of chunk 1 reads the exact data from ram_1_r (via the combinational mux mux_out_w after the RAM read registers at bram_input_buffer.v:L139).
Expected_result: Two chunks chain back-to-back with 0 idle cycles (zero-bubble); beat 0 of chunk 1 does not read stale data from bank 0.
Notes: Verifies the cycle-accurate design at bram_input_buffer.v:L125-L144 (synchronously reading both RAM banks and combinationally muxing by rd_bank_r enables instant bank switching with zero pipeline bubble).
Golden_Reference_Rule: valid_delay_o == 1 continuously for 128 cycles when chaining two k_dim=64 chunks; C32 matches golden.
Bug_Injection_Target: Moving the rd_bank_r mux before the RAM read register in bram_input_buffer.v -> first beat on go_chain_w=1 reads from the old bank -> TB reports FAIL.
Pass_Criteria: 0 bubble cycles between chunks; C32 matches 100%.

Objective: Verify post_accumulator reduction across multiple num_k_tiles_i settings: 1 (directly overwrites tile 0 without adding stale data in acc_ram_r), 2, 4, 8 (256/32), and 16.
Stimulus: Run 3 jobs back-to-back without reset in between: Job 1 with num_k_tiles_i=8 and large values to fill acc_ram_r; Job 2 with num_k_tiles_i=1; and Job 3 with num_k_tiles_i=16.
Checks: Verify that at tile_cnt_r==0 (line 44 of post_accumulator.v), acc_ram_r is completely overwritten by the new tile without accumulating residual values from Job 1; for tile_cnt_r > 0, it accumulates accurately across num_k_tiles_i tiles before transitioning to S_OUTPUT.
Expected_result: Results of all 3 consecutive jobs with num_k_tiles = 8, 1, 16 match the exact mathematical sum of each individual job.
coverage_target: cg_post_acc: nt_1_overwrite, nt_2, nt_4, nt_8, nt_16, consecutive_jobs_no_leak (100%)
Notes: If the condition (tile_cnt_r == 32'd0) at line 44 fails, Job 2 will accumulate on top of leftover results in acc_ram_r from Job 1.
Golden_Reference_Rule: For each output block: C32 = sum_{t=0}^{num_k_tiles-1} Tile_C32[t].
Bug_Injection_Target: Corrupting line 44 of post_accumulator.v or failing to reset tile_cnt_r to 0 after num_k_tiles_i -> Job 2 accumulates garbage from Job 1 -> TB reports FAIL.
Pass_Criteria: 0 data leakage across consecutive jobs; all num_k_tiles settings match 100%.

Category: Asymmetric Input Streaming A vs B
Objective: Verify asymmetric arrival timing between AXI-Stream Slave A and Slave B (stream A fills both banks before stream B even starts, and vice versa) combined with randomly intermittent tvalid_i.
Stimulus: Experiment 1: Fill 2 full chunks into s_axis_a (64 beats) while holding s_axis_b_tvalid_i=0; verify s_axis_a_tready_o drops to 0 once both A banks are full; then stream s_axis_b with 25% tvalid probability. Experiment 2: Reverse roles so B fills first and A streams slowly.
Checks: Verify systolic_dataflow_ctrl starts only when BOTH bram_ready_A_i AND bram_ready_B_i are asserted; no beat of A or B is dropped or overwritten while waiting for the other channel.
Expected_result: The faster channel automatically stalls (tready_o=0) when both banks are full; the systolic array waits for both A and B before computing; C32 matches 100%.
Notes: In practice, l2_tiling_agu loads all of A for a K-block into GBUFA before loading B into GBUFB, or streams A and B at different rates.
Golden_Reference_Rule: Standard AXIS handshake: a beat is accepted if and only if (tvalid && tready).
Bug_Injection_Target: Changing go_idle_w at systolic_dataflow_ctrl.v:L67 from (bram_ready_A_i && bram_ready_B_i) to (bram_ready_A_i || bram_ready_B_i) -> array starts before B finishes loading -> TB reports FAIL.
Pass_Criteria: 0 dropped beats; 100% C32 results match golden.

Objective: Verify AXI-Stream protocol compliance on output port m_axis_c32 when the downstream sink (l2_tiling_agu) randomly deasserts m_axis_c32_tready_i=0 or holds it low for extended periods while outputting 16 rows.
Stimulus: Run 8 consecutive output tiles (k_dim=32, num_k_tiles=2); drive m_axis_c32_tready_i randomly (including holding tready=0 for 50 cycles right at row 0 SOF, middle row 7, and row 15 EOF).
Checks: Verify the AXIS stability invariant: whenever (m_axis_c32_tvalid_o==1 && m_axis_c32_tready_i==0), all three signals m_axis_c32_tdata_o, m_axis_c32_tlast_o, and m_axis_c32_tuser_o must remain unchanged on the next cycle; no row is dropped or duplicated.
Expected_result: All 16/16 rows of all 8 tiles are captured completely and in order; SVA reports zero AXIS payload stability violations.
Notes: Directly tests line 107 of post_accumulator.v: if (!m_axis_tvalid_o || m_axis_tready_i).
Bug_Injection_Target: Removing the (!m_axis_tvalid_o || m_axis_tready_i) condition at post_accumulator.v:L107 -> output rows are lost when tready=0 -> TB and SVA report FAIL immediately.
Pass_Criteria: 0 AXIS protocol violations; 8/8 tiles match bit-exact.

Category: FIFO C High-Water Stall & Overflow Protection
Objective: Verify FIFO C (DEPTH=1024) overflow protection: when downstream output is stalled long enough for the row count in FIFO C to reach fifo_hiwater_w (>= 1024 - 128 = 896 rows), stall_i=1 must pause systolic_dataflow_ctrl from launching new chunks.
Stimulus: Hold m_axis_c32_tready_i = 0 at the output; set num_k_tiles_i = 100 (or stall FIFO reads by holding post_accumulator in S_OUTPUT with m_axis_tready_i=0) while continuously feeding over 60 tiles (60 x 16 = 960 rows) into inputs A/B. Once fifo_hiwater_w=1 and inputs stall, re-enable m_axis_c32_tready_i = 1.
Checks: Verify that when fifo_cnt_r reaches 896, fifo_hiwater_w asserts to 1, systolic_dataflow_ctrl stops launching new chunks, fifo_full_w is never violated (zero writes while fifo_full_w==1), and after re-asserting m_axis_c32_tready_i=1 all 60 tiles drain accurately.
Expected_result: FIFO C never overflows (0 occurrences of wr_en && full); the core recovers automatically and outputs all 60 tiles accurately after releasing the stall.
Notes: Verifies the FIFO C overflow protection added in RTL v7 (gemm_compute_core.v lines 82-90).
Golden_Reference_Rule: Never (fifo_wr_en_w && fifo_full_w); total rows written == total rows read.
Bug_Injection_Target: Hardwiring stall_i = 1'b0 at gemm_compute_core.v:L122 while holding m_axis_c32_tready_i=0 -> FIFO C overflows and drops rows -> TB reports FAIL.
Pass_Criteria: 0 FIFO C overflows; 100% of tiles match golden after releasing tready.

Objective: Verify First-Word Fall-Through (FWFT) behavior of sc_fifo_fwft across sensitive state transitions: empty to 1-element, 1-element to empty, and simultaneous read/write (wr_en_i=1 && rd_en_i=1) across fill levels.
Stimulus: Modulate chunk feeding rate and m_axis_c32_tready_i consumption rate so fifo_cnt_r oscillates around 0 -> 1 -> 0 and 1 -> 2 -> 1 with simultaneous read/write cycles.
Checks: Verify that as soon as empty_o drops to 0, dout_o already presents valid first-element data without waiting for a prior rd_en_i pulse; verify fifo_cnt_r in gemm_compute_core always matches the actual occupancy inside sc_fifo_fwft.
Expected_result: No element is read twice or skipped during simultaneous read and write operations.
Notes: The interface between sc_fifo_fwft (FWFT) and post_accumulator relies on dout_o being valid immediately when ~empty_o = 1.
Golden_Reference_Rule: Every row pushed into the FIFO at index FIFO_in[m] must exit at FIFO_out[m].
Bug_Injection_Target: Delaying dout_o of sc_fifo_fwft by 1 cycle after rd_en_i (turning it into a standard FIFO instead of FWFT) -> post_accumulator reads stale first row -> TB reports FAIL.
Pass_Criteria: 100% of rows passing through the FIFO preserve exact order and value.

Objective: Verify dynamic on-the-fly updates to num_k_tiles_i between K-blocks (matching how l2_tiling_agu switches c_nch_r from nch_full=8 on a full K-block to nch_tail=1..7 on a boundary tail K-block).
Stimulus: Run 4 consecutive output blocks without reset: Block 1 has num_k_tiles_i=8; while the final tile of Block 1 is being received in post_accumulator, change num_k_tiles_i to 3 for Block 2, then to 1 for Block 3, and back to 8 for Block 4 (emulating line 788 of l2_tiling_agu.v).
Checks: Verify Block 1 finishes after 8 tiles, Block 2 after 3 tiles, Block 3 after 1 tile, and Block 4 after 8 tiles with no boundary slippage between blocks.
Expected_result: All 4 output blocks emit 16 rows/block with accumulated sums matching their respective tile counts (8, 3, 1, 8).
Notes: In l2_tiling_agu.v:L788, c_nch_r is updated early for the next K-block while post_accumulator is receiving the first tile of that block.
Golden_Reference_Rule: Block b accumulates exactly num_k_tiles[b] chunks.
Bug_Injection_Target: Latching num_k_tiles_i only once after reset -> odd K-tail blocks hang waiting for 8 tiles -> TB reports timeout/FAIL.
Pass_Criteria: 4/4 blocks with dynamic tile counts (8, 3, 1, 8) match golden 100%.

Objective: Verify individual isolation of each of the 256 PEs (PE[r][c] for r=0..15, c=0..15) to ensure no cross-row/column wiring bugs or data leakage along the vertical psum_w[0..16][0..15] drain chain.
Stimulus: Drive one-hot / identity matrix patterns such that in each tile only a single row r0 of A and a single column c0 of B are non-zero (sweeping all 16 rows x 16 columns).
Checks: Verify that among the 256 output elements of the tile, only element C32[r0][c0] is non-zero while all other 255 elements are strictly 0.
Expected_result: Zero cross-contamination into adjacent rows r0+-1 or columns c0+-1 during horizontal act_o propagation, vertical weight_o propagation, or vertical psum_down_o shifting.
Notes: Exhaustively detects any index wiring typo among the 256 PEs in systolic_array_os.v.
Golden_Reference_Rule: C32[i][j] != 0 if and only if (i == r0 && j == c0).
Bug_Injection_Target: Cross-wiring psum_w or act_w between two adjacent columns/rows -> neighboring cells become non-zero -> TB reports FAIL.

Objective: Verify mid-flight task abort and clean recovery when asserting RST_i=0 while the systolic array is computing, the serializer is draining, and post_accumulator is mid-accumulation.
Stimulus: Stream 1.5 tiles (num_k_tiles_i=4, mid-way through tile 2) with large values; assert RST_i=0 for 5 cycles; then release RST_i=1 and run a fresh job (k_dim=32, num_k_tiles=2).
Checks: Verify after RST_i=1: fifo_cnt_r==0, fifo_empty_w==1, both A/B BRAM banks are empty (tready_o=1), and the new job produces results completely uncontaminated by partial sums from before reset.
Expected_result: The new job after mid-flight reset completes on time and matches golden 100% with zero leftover garbage from the aborted run.
Notes: Ensures all state registers across all 7 submodules have complete synchronous reset branches.
Golden_Reference_Rule: All internal states return to default after RST_i=0; new job matches golden 100%.
Bug_Injection_Target: Omitting reset on tile_cnt_r or row_cnt_r in post_accumulator.v or wr_ptr_r in bram_input_buffer.v -> post-reset job goes out of phase -> TB reports FAIL.
Pass_Criteria: Post-reset job achieves 0 bit-exact errors and 0 protocol errors.

Objective: Verify actual cycle performance of gemm_compute_core during sustained streaming (16 consecutive tiles with k_dim=32 and k_dim=64) against the theoretical cycle model.
Stimulus: Continuously stream 16 tiles (k_dim=64, num_k_tiles=4 -> 4 output blocks, 1024 total K steps) with zero input bubbles and m_axis_c32_tready_i=1. Repeat with k_dim=32 (16 tiles x 32 K steps).
Checks: Measure total cycles from the first beat entering BRAM to the final beat exiting post_accumulator. For k_dim=64, PE array utilization must exceed 90% (zero-bubble between chunks); for k_dim=32, the period per chunk must equal MIN_PERIOD=48.
Expected_result: At k_dim=64: time per chunk after the first chunk equals exactly 64 cycles (0 dead cycles); at k_dim=32: time per chunk equals 48 cycles.
Notes: Detects throughput degradation bugs (performance bugs) that purely functional tests would miss.
Golden_Reference_Rule: Cycles per chunk = max(k_dim, 48) when ping-pong BRAMs are continuously supplied.
Bug_Injection_Target: Disabling the if (go_chain_w) branch at systolic_dataflow_ctrl.v:L101 (always routing through DONE -> IDLE) -> each chunk slows down by 2-3 cycles -> performance test reports FAIL.
Pass_Criteria: Measured cycle count matches theoretical formula within +-2 startup cycles.

Objective: Run an integrated stress test (100 tiles with randomized data, k_dim, num_k_tiles, input tvalid bubbles, and output tready back-pressure driven by seed).
Stimulus: Run 25 output blocks (~100 total tiles) with seed (+SEED=): randomize k_dim in {16, 32, 64, 128, 256}, num_k_tiles in {1..8}, s_axis_a/b_tvalid probability in [30%..100%], and m_axis_c32_tready probability in [20%..100%].
Checks: Compare all captured C32 rows against the Golden Matmul Scoreboard; check 100% of SVA assertions (AXIS stability, FIFO no-overflow/underflow, MIN_PERIOD) and 100% functional coverage.
Expected_result: All 25 output blocks (6,400 INT32 elements) match bit-exact 100%; 0 SVA errors; 100% functional coverage achieved.
Notes: Comprehensive stress test certifying the 16x16 compute core operates flawlessly under chaotic dataflow conditions.
Golden_Reference_Rule: 100% bit-exact match against the reference INT8->INT32 matrix multiplication.
Bug_Injection_Target: Any race condition between ping-pong BRAMs, systolic drain, FIFO C, and post_accumulator is exposed under randomized tvalid/tready.
Pass_Criteria: 0 data errors; 0 SVA errors; Functional Coverage = 100%.
